claim: This leaf's OWN state/cost addition (the scene-A extended-half insert bus wiring, the ains3->ains4 schedule, the gating/lifecycle control state, plus its synthetic per-slot occupant kernel) -- NOT the ext-mem footprint of whichever concrete Surge FX algorithm actually occupies ains3/ains4 in a real preset, which is that algorithm leaf's own SXT-015/016 accounting.

external_writable_memory.note: the synthetic occupant kernel (BiquadInstance) is register-only (on-chip); it touches no external buffer. A concrete tail-bearing occupant (Delay/Reverb1/Reverb2/Chorus/etc.) landed in ains3 or ains4 owns its own external-memory accounting separately, and its long buffers must live in external WRITABLE memory -- never flash (AGENTS.md).

external_traffic.note: no external-memory transactions originate from this leaf's own routing/scheduling/lifecycle logic or its synthetic occupant

on_chip_small_state.note: two instances (ains3, ains4) = 2 x 321 bits + 21 shared routing/lifecycle control bits = 663 bits on-chip total for this leaf's own contribution

ext_mem_traffic_estimate: [PENDING-SXT-016] this leaf's own contribution is 0 words/sample (see external_traffic above); the AGGREGATE estimate for a concrete preset also depends on whichever algorithm leaf's occupant actually lands in ains3/ains4 (e.g. Reverb 1 + EQ for Sand Storm.fxp, Reverb 2 + EQ for Brass Ensemble.fxp, Phaser for Jigsaw.fxp), which is out of this leaf's scope -- no aggregate number is invented here
long_buffers_policy: delay/reverb-class buffers live in external WRITABLE memory; processing stays on-chip; flash is not writable delay memory (AGENTS.md) -- not applicable to this leaf's own (register-only) contribution
scene_bus_note: this leaf accounts for the EXTENDED half (slots 3-4) of ONE scene's insert chain (scene A). The ains1/ains2 base half of the same chain, the scene-B insert bus (rf-bins*, slots 1-2 landed as rf-rf-bins12), the send buses (rf-send*) and the global bus (rf-global*, slot 2 landed as rf-rf-global2) each carry their own instances and their own accounting; nothing here is a per-patch total.
comparability_note: identical in structure and word format to the landed sibling routing leaf rf-rf-bins12 (same 663-bit total), which is deliberate: the two insert halves are directly comparable.
